verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs show it directly running a GGUF file, with `local-ai run huggingface://TheBloke/phi-2-GGUF/phi-2.Q8_0.gguf`. They also reference tool-call autodetection for 'any ggml/gguf model', which confirms GGUF is a supported model format. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on GGUF loading (backend, supported quantization levels, local-file loading) and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format

citations.quote: the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support
